title: Local Epochs as Optimal Stopping: Theory and Evidence in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How long should each client train before communicating? Federated learning usually answers with a fixed, hand-tuned number of local epochs, yet an extra epoch helps only while the loss it removes outweighs the client drift it adds. We cast local training as finite-horizon optimal stopping: a client trains while the next epoch's expected loss reduction exceeds its priced squared drift. We prove that this one-stage look-ahead threshold is optimal whenever stopping decisions are nested, derive closed forms for geometric and power-law returns, and show that an estimated rule loses utility only through wrong-signed decisions. Epoch-level evidence supports the model's structure (geometric diminishing returns and additive drift) and reveals a simple regularity: the stage of training, not the client, sets the budget. translated_title: 局部轮次作为最优停止：联邦学习中的理论与证据
translated_abstract: 每个客户端在通信之前应该训练多久？联邦学习通常以一个固定的、手工调优的局部轮次数来回答这个问题，然而多训一个轮次只有在它消除的损失超过其引入的客户端漂移时才有益。我们将局部训练建模为有限时域的最优停止问题：只要下一轮次的期望损失下降超过其定价后的平方漂移，客户端就继续训练。我们证明，只要停止决策是嵌套的，这一单阶段前瞻阈值就是最优的；推导了几何型收益和幂律型收益下的闭式解；并表明估计得到的规则只会因符号错误的决策而损失效用。轮次层面的证据支持该模型的结构（几何递减收益与加性漂移），并揭示出一个简单的规律：决定局部训练预算的是训练所处的阶段，而非客户端本身。由此得到的规则 FedStop 在平均准确率上从不比经过调优的 FedAvg 低超过一个百分点；在其预算发生变化之处，它提升了 w……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将联邦学习中的局部训练轮次选择建模为最优停止问题，证明了单阶段前瞻阈值规则的最优性，并据此提出 FedStop 算法——它根据训练阶段而非客户端自适应地分配局部训练预算，平均准确率不低于调优后的 FedAvg。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the choice of local epochs in federated learning as an optimal stopping problem, proves the optimality of a one-stage look-ahead threshold rule, and derives FedStop, which adaptively allocates local training budgets based on training stage rather than client identity, never falling more than one point below tuned FedAvg in mean accuracy.
